title: Lock accounts after failed logins
notes: Synthetic change to the demo shop with seeded defects.

defects.summary: The account locks only after the 6th failure: the comparison is > instead of >=.
defects.caught_if: a condition fails 5 times and checks the account is locked (and not after 4)
defects.observed: after 5 failures check() did not raise LockedOut

defects.summary: A successful login does not reset the failure count.
defects.caught_if: a condition fails, succeeds, then fails again and checks the count started over (no lock after 2 new failures)
defects.observed: 4 failures, a success, 2 failures: account locked
